purpose: End-to-end real Cookery food procurement, shipment, frontline consumption and recoverable morale effect on the isolated Folia fixture.

environment.starcore: 1.0.0; ArmyService used for test army creation and persistence
environment.descriptor_note: Only the isolated runtime test JAR adds folia-supported:true. The production JAR and source plugin.yml do not declare Folia support.

agriculture.actions: player planted and bonemealed wheat, then harvested it in survival

millstone.method: player inserted wheat into Cookery millstone and moved around it; no direct inventory grant

steamer.method: real Cookery steamer, single dough insert, empty-hand sneak lid interaction, heat wait, normal item retrieval

shipment.duplicate_delivery: returned existing DELIVERED state and same settlement UUID

frontline_and_war_effect.army_created_via: StarCore ArmyService.createArmy; cost 1000.00 paid by Alpha treasury; persisted in StarCore army state and restored on restart
frontline_and_war_effect.rebind_preserved: front location, physical item lots, route and delivered shipment records
frontline_and_war_effect.recovery_property: StarSupply's morale contribution follows current food coverage and is not a persistent debit: 45% coverage produced -5.5 (effective 94.5 from base 100), and after the single mantou was consumed the contribution returned to -10 (effective 90). This proves a reversible temporary contribution, not full-supply recovery or restoration of previously lost StarCore base morale.

native_starcore_supply_follow_up.finding: StarCore has an independent persisted supply and morale maintenance path. ArmyService.updateArmy consumes ceil(supplyConsumptionPerHour / 60) every minute; for the stationary rate of 1 point/hour this consumes 1 point/minute. Once native supply is below 20, ArmyUnit.consumeSupply subtracts 5 saved morale points and ArmyService.updateArmy subtracts another 2 during that minute update, for up to 7 points/minute; below 10 it may disband the army.
native_starcore_supply_follow_up.runtime_evidence: The retained loop snapshot records this army at base morale 100 and native supply 72. A later line in the isolated runtime log records the same army disbanded at morale 2; that run predates the maintenance correction. The retained snapshots do not capture an intermediate base-morale value of 86, so that exact transition cannot be attributed from the archived timeline; the StarCore starvation path was the confirmed independent source of persistent erosion, while StarSupply's temporary modifier does not write base morale.
native_starcore_supply_follow_up.maintenance_correction: The current upstream patch accumulates hourly consumption across minute updates, removes the duplicate model-side morale debit, applies one -2 starvation debit below native supply 20, and restores +1 morale per minute once native supply is at least 20. Targeted StarCore tests: 19 passed, 0 failed.
native_starcore_supply_follow_up.integration_limit: StarSupply deliveries and food lots do not replenish StarCore's native 0-100 supply meter. StarCore's public resupplyArmy(UUID) independently charges the treasury and has no request-level idempotency receipt, so it cannot safely be called as a side effect of an already-paid item purchase.

remaining_limits: Production plugin.yml still has no folia-supported declaration; this isolated test does not establish complete Folia support for StarSupply, pinned StarCore or every optional-plugin combination.
This run proves one FOOD item through the production chain, not sustained supply or all six resources; continuous farming/production and additional resources are still needed for full coverage.
Other trade rejection branches, all restart/interrupt boundaries, world unload and full Folia module coverage remain separate acceptance work.
